newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai B shares end down on correction.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai B shares end down on correction.

text.p: Shanghai B shares ended down on Wednesday on a correction after gains on Tuesday, brokers said.
The index fell 0.403 point or 0.77 percent to 51.866 points, on volume of 11.5 million shares worth $4.6 million. Of 41 B shares, 36 traded, with 21 down, six flat and nine up.
Brokers said that profit-taking pushed the index down, but overseas institutions bought stocks with good prospects.
"Overseas buying was very selective, because only a few companies had good interim result," one broker said. "Most poor stocks will be ignored by the market for some time."
"Investors continue to adjust their positions according to interim results and there will not be sharp ups and downs in the short term," a second broker said.
Shanghai Jintai was the biggest loser on disappointing interim results posted on Wednesday, down $0.032 or 17.77 percent to $0.148, on volume of 80,000 shares.
Tientsin Marine traded the most and ended up on expectations of good interim results, brokers said. It gained $0.002 or 0.64 percent to $0.312, on volume of 2.6 million shares.

Shanghai A shares ended up on a technical rebound, but the market direction was still unclear because more interim results will come out in the next few days, brokers said. All interim results are due out by the end of August.
The A index rose 10.247 points or 1.25 percent to 832.936 points, on volume of 324.6 million shares worth 2.9 billion yuan. The SSE 30 index gained 45.951 points or 2.19 percent to 2144.831 points.
FAW Sihuan was the star on institutional buying, soaring 2.59 yuan or 18.39 percent to 16.67 yuan, on volume of 7.0 million shares.
